title: Make task-record normalization collision-safe
description: Harden Scripts/Normalize-TaskRecords.ps1 so normalization cannot silently create duplicate task keys while repairing filename/key drift. The current script derives a filename-based key and overwrites a stale stored key without checking whether another record already owns that target key. This is especially dangerous when independently-created branches allocate the same TSK number. Add a preflight pass that parses all task records, computes each record's post-normalization id/key identity, detects duplicate target IDs/keys and collisions with surviving records, and fails before writing any file. Preserve the existing deterministic normalization behavior for non-conflicting records. Do not add CI infrastructure; this is a local safety guard for the normalization utility.

comments.author: anonymous
comments.body: Source-level review found Fix 2b in Normalize-TaskRecords.ps1 changes a present key to the filename-derived key without first checking whether that target key is already owned by another task. The normalizer can therefore manufacture a duplicate key during a collision-reconciliation operation. Fixed by adding a preflight identity/collision pass that aborts before any writes when normalized ids or keys would collide.
